0022600109.text: The Mavericks (1-1, third in the Southwest and ninth in the West) host the Spurs (0-2, fifth in the Southwest and 12th in the West) in their third game of the 2026-27 season, with Dallas coming off a win and San Antonio on a two-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost all four games to San Antonio, most recently a 139-120 defeat in San Antonio on April 10, 2026. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin, Cooper Flagg, Dereck Lively II, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic, who are out, and Kyrie Irving, Max Christie, Morez Johnson Jr. and Zaccharie Risacher, who are listed as day-to-day, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance and Tobias Harris, who are both out.
